title: Pin exception risk ledger and legal notification scripts
body:
Purpose:
This doc centralizes a compact, operationally-actionable "ledger" for region-pin exceptions (customer-level waivers, temporary cross-region fallbacks, and contract-level carveouts). It pairs each ledger row with the minimal legal notification script and the telemetry/rollback triggers that SRE and CSM should use. The goal is to reduce ad-hoc email threads and make every exception auditable and machine-readable by the operator runbook.

Scope:
- Applies to Hosted + Dedicated tenants where a customer requests deviation from their default region pin (temporary or permanent).
- Covers approval status, risk classification, legal notice templates, telemetry hooks, expiry conditions, and rollback triggers.
- Not a replacement for full contracts — this is an operational artifact to support cross-team handoffs.

How to use this ledger (operator flow):
1) Create a new ledger row in the canonical spreadsheet (link in linked_artifacts).
2) Attach the signed exception approval (PDF) and set status = requested.
3) Legal reviews and sets "acceptance_level" (legal-OK | requires-SLA-mod | denied).
4) Eng assigns temporary pin plan and records telemetry hooks.
5) SRE creates canary with monitoring alerts and automatic eviction triggers.
6) After acceptance period, either close as permanent or execute rollback.

Sample ledger row (single-line format for human copy):
- tenant_id: ACME-12345 | requested_by: Marco Li | requested_at: 2025-09-25 | region_from: eu-west-1 | region_to: us-east-1 | reason_summary: "integration with on-prem ML infra; customer requires low-latency to corp data center" | duration: 90d (temp) | legal_status: pending | risk_level: medium-high | telemetry_tags: [pin-exc-acme, latency-stats, kv-miss-rate] | ops_owner: Hannah Ortiz | rollback_trigger: "error-rate>3% for 20m OR data-evidence-mismatch" | evidence_bucket: s3://residency-evidence/acme-12345/

Risk classification guidance (quick):
- Low: transient dev sandbox, limited PII (accept w/ email notice + 7d expiry)
- Medium: production non-PII workloads (require SLA mod + 30d probation + extra telemetry)
- High: any PII/regulatory scope (requires legal signoff, engineering design review, escrow anchor)

Telemetry & SLO hooks to attach to exception: (operator checklist)
- Add metric namespace: residency.exception.<tenant_id>.latency
- Trace sampling: ensure full traces for first 24h post-change
- KV prefix hits: export prefix hit rate for affected tenants
- Audit log snapshot: daily snapshot of routing decisions for retention 90d
- Canary policy: 5% traffic, 30m ramp, automatic rollback on error-rate threshold

Minimal legal notification script (email / ticket text) — send when legal_status moves to accepted:
Subject: Redwood residency exception accepted — ACME-12345 (temporary pin)
Body:
Hi <Legal/Customer Contact>,

This confirms Redwood has approved a temporary region pin exception for tenant ACME-12345. Summary: allowed routing to us-east-1 for 90 days for integration testing. Risks acknowledged: cross-border transfer of telemetry metadata; customer owns consent for any EU/UK data moved to the US.

Operator actions we will take:
- Maintain canary with telemetry tags: pin-exc-acme.
- Daily audit bundle exported to the evidence bucket.
- Rolling rollback if defined triggers occur.

If you need additional contractual language, please reference contract addendum template: confluence:RESID-EXC-898.

Signature:
Redwood Legal / Engineering Ops

Escalation script (on-call):
- If the canary hits rollback_trigger, page SRE on-call + notify CSM + legal.
- Immediate mitigation: revert region pin for the tenant and preserve evidence snapshot.
- Logging: tag incident with jira:PD-1298 and attach snapshot URL.

Acceptance criteria for permanentization (check all):
- 30d of canary with zero high-severity incidents
- Telemetry shows latency within agreed bounds (p99 within 20% of pre-exception baseline)
- Legal receives audit bundle and marks "compliance-reviewed" in ledger
- Finance has approved any pricing delta for sustained dedicated anchoring

Rollback triggers (operationally actionable):
- error-rate > 3% sustained for 20 minutes
- data-classification mismatches detected by content scanner and flagged by legal
- unexpected egress pattern > 3x baseline for 1 hour
- repeated operator overrides without documented approval

Packaging evidence for audits (operator checklist):
- Single compressed archive per day with: routing decisions CSV, trace samples (first 24h), audit log slice, signed acceptance form.
- Store in s3://residency-audit/YYYY/MM/DD/<tenant_id>.zip and record location in ledger row.
- Retain copies per contract (default 90d), longer when requested by Legal.

Open questions / unresolved items (action owners):
- Can automation surface the ledger row as a YAML attachment to tenant config? (ACTION: infra, Ravi, due 2025-11-01)
- Should we build an alert that auto-prepares the evidence bundle on rollback? (ACTION: SRE, Hannah, due 2025-11-15)
- Pricing model for long-running exceptions (ACTION: Finance & Sales, Marco, due 2025-12-01)

Appendix: quick links and templates
- Addendum template: confluence:RESID-EXC-898
- Evidence packaging lambda: github:repo/infra-pin-sync/blob/main/tools/evidence-bundle.py
- Example acceptance PDF: s3://redwood-internal/residency/samples/acceptance-acme-2025-09.pdf

Notes-to-self (informal):
- keep ledger rows terse; put long rationale in linked PR/Confluence page
- prefer automated evidence bundles; manual zips are error-prone
- keep legal email script minimal to avoid creating new contract obligations

If you are editing this doc: add a single line to the top log with date, initials, and short note.

Last edits: 2026-02-12 (Priya) — moved rollback triggers to top-level checklist and added telemetry tags recommendation.
